candidate_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab (other names: Avastin, Anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody): Intravenous bevacizumab at a 600 mg flat dose every three weeks for four courses over 12 weeks
Dexamethasone (other names: Corticosteroids): Daily oral dexamethasone followed by a protocol-based tapering dose over 12 weeks

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First episode of sCRN ≥ 3 months after completion of focal (re-)irradiation

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab and dexamethasone serum and plasma concentrations pre- and post-dose

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Immuno-oncology proteins as blood-based biomarkers for (early) treatment response in both treatment arms using Olink Target 96 Immuno-oncology panel

role_evidence.quote: Intravenous bevacizumab at a 600 mg flat dose every three weeks for four courses over 12 weeks
Daily oral dexamethasone followed by a protocol-based tapering dose over 12 weeks

coder_notes: Trial treats symptomatic cerebral radiation necrosis (after irradiation of high-grade glioma or brain metastases), not tumour. Population is HGG (glioblastoma named in inclusion) plus brain metastases of any solid tumour; coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (could be argued basket). Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) tested in a new setting, so established_therapy_experiment. Dexamethasone is comparator, optionally allowed alongside bevacizumab. No tumour molecular biomarkers listed; IDH appears only in the WHO 2021 diagnostic definition; Olink and platelet RNA are blood-based exploratory markers.
